local Ray = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()
local Replicated = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Win = Ray:CreateWindow({
    Name = "OTR Morphs Script",
    LoadingTitle = "Loading the script wait lil bro",
    LoadingSubtitle = "by Miyun",
    ConfigurationSaving = { Enabled = false },
    KeySystem = false,
    Theme = "AmberGlow"
})

local function doMorph(name, remote)
    local charChange = Replicated:FindFirstChild("CharChange")
    if not charChange then error("no remote") end
    
    local target = Replicated:FindFirstChild(remote)
    if not target then error("no target") end
    
    local args = { target }
    charChange:FireServer(unpack(args))
end

local Tab1 = Win:CreateTab("Gamepass & Badge Morphs")
Tab1:CreateSection("Morphs that make u spend ur parents credits card or afk")

Tab1:CreateButton({
    Name = "UTCLM (Upgraded Titan Clock Man)",
    Callback = function() doMorph("UTCLM", "UPGRADEDTITANCLOCKDIGI") end,
})

Tab1:CreateButton({
    Name = "UTDM (Upgraded Titan Drill Man)",

Tab1:CreateButton({

Tab1:CreateButton({

Tab3:CreateButton({
    Name = "Sans",
    Callback = function() doMorph("Sans", "Sans") end,
})

local Tab4 = Win:CreateTab("Settings")
Tab4:CreateSection("No lag")

local original = {}
Tab4:CreateToggle({
    Name = "FPS Boost",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Flag = "boost",
    Callback = function(val)
        if val then
            game:GetService("Lighting").GlobalShadows = false
            for _, v in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if v:IsA("Texture") or v:IsA("Decal") then
                    original[v] = v.Texture
                    v.Texture = ""
                elseif v:IsA("MeshPart") then
                    original[v] = v.RenderFidelity
                    v.RenderFidelity = Enum.RenderFidelity.Performance
                elseif v:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
                    original[v] = v.TextureId
                    v.TextureId = ""
                elseif v:IsA("Part") or v:IsA("CornerWedgePart") then
                    original[v] = v.Material
                    v.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                end
            end
        else
            game:GetService("Lighting").GlobalShadows = true
            for v, data in pairs(original) do
                if v and v.Parent then
                    if v:IsA("Texture") or v:IsA("Decal") then
                        v.Texture = data
                    elseif v:IsA("MeshPart") then
                        v.RenderFidelity = data
                    elseif v:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
                        v.TextureId = data
                    elseif v:IsA("Part") then
                        v.Material = data
                    end
                end
            end
            table.clear(original)
        end
    end,
})

local fogEnd, fogStart
Tab4:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Clear Fog",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Flag = "fog",
    Callback = function(val)
        local l = game:GetService("Lighting")
        if val then
            fogEnd = l.FogEnd
            fogStart = l.FogStart
            l.FogEnd = 999999
            l.FogStart = 999999
        else
            l.FogEnd = fogEnd or 1000
            l.FogStart = fogStart or 0
        end
    end
})

Tab4:CreateSection("Danger zone")

Tab4:CreateButton({
    Name = "Kill script",
    Callback = function()
        Ray:Destroy()
    end,
})
